Package com.sca4d.app.server.controllers

Class AuthenticationAttemptController

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.app.server.controllers.AuthenticationAttemptController
@RestController @RequestMapping public class AuthenticationAttemptController extends Object
向跨请求登录或登录后动作认证尝试提交认证材料。
